$comment: Provisional manifest — formalized by the Media entity schema (history-alive-y0u.2). Verified against the original print (mourning card: 'Oberst Hentsch † Generalstabschef der Militär-Verwaltung in Rumänien, gest. am 13. Februar 1918').

original.description: Catalogue title (Landesarchiv BW): 'Richard Hentsch, Oberst und Generalstabschef Militärverwaltung Rumäniens, stehend in Uniform mit Orden hinter Schreibtisch, Brustbild in Halbprofil' — standing in uniform with orders behind a desk, bust-length in half-profile; mounted photograph 19.5 × 13 cm with mourning border, 1918.
original.photographer: not identified (from the estate of Dr. Johannes Friedrich Rudolph von Goetz, 1856–1941, military physician)
original.archive: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Hauptstaatsarchiv Stuttgart, Militärhistorische Bildsammlung, M 703 R959N4 — via Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek and Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: CC-BY 3.0 DE (attribution: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, HStA Stuttgart M 703 R959N4) and public domain in the US (pre-1931)

colorization.author: Dave Tashner / History Alive
colorization.licence: History Alive project licence with CC-BY attribution to the Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek
colorization.status: ok — verified against the original on 2026-08-22: the print shows Hentsch standing behind the desk, hands on the papers, maps on the wall and a framed picture top-left, exactly as in the colorized image (the catalogue's 'Brustbild' undersells the crop). Only the mourning-card mount and its printed caption were cropped away. Label 'colorized (AI-assisted)'; documented colours: feldgrau tunic with red piping, gold shoulder boards; the rest interpretive.

caption: Richard Hentsch (1869–1918), Oberstleutnant of the General Staff — sent by Moltke on 8 September 1914 to tour the army headquarters with authority to order a retreat; his visit to Bülow and Kluck on 8–9 September ended the German advance at the Marne. Photographed in 1918. Colorized (AI-assisted).
credit: Original photograph: J. F. R. von Goetz, 1918, Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek, CC-BY 3.0 (via Wikimedia Commons). Colorization: History Alive, AI-assisted, 2026.
notes: Provided by Dave 2026-08-22. The single image in the set that needs a fidelity check before it is used — the scene looks richer than a 387 × 600 bust portrait would support.
